title: Disable skill until HP is below a certain threshold script?

posts.author: MoltresRider
posts.body:
I am looking for an RPG Maker VX Ace script that prohibits the user from using certain skills until that character's HP is below a certain percentage of their maximum.
Ideally, I would put in the skill's notebox something like
<Available Below: 30> meaning the skill becomes available when the character's HP is below 30%
I would like this to prevent spamming of clutch HP draining moves unless the character actually needs it.
Could I please get someone to make me something like this? Please and thank you.

posts.author: Roninator2
posts.body:
Yanfly skill restrictions
<restrict eval>
a.hp < (a.mhp * 30)
</restrict eval>
Not tested.
Might be 'self' and not 'a' like Trihan says below.
<restrict eval>
self.hp < (self.mhp * 30)
</restrict eval>

posts.author: MoltresRider
posts.body:
self works but the move was available even at 100% health.
However, ChatGPT told me to make it
Ruby:
<restrict eval>
self.hp > (self.mhp * 0.30)
</restrict eval>
Because it disables if true, not if false and this disables it unless HP is less than 30%
Now is it possible to make an
item
only usable when the
entire party
is less than 30% with restrict eval?
